name: Tendril.js
description: Liquid Rope & Ink Physics Engine. Frame-rate independent Verlet kinematics synthesized with SVG gooey fluid dynamics.

settings.name: Rope Tension (Lag)
settings.description: Frame-rate independent exponential smoothing lag time constant per segment. Lower (15ms) = rigid, snappy follow; Higher (80ms) = loose floating trailing cord.

settings.name: Tension Sensitivity
settings.description: Multiplier for dynamic tension build-up when cursor stretches away from anchor pins. 2.5x snaps spans taut rapidly; 0.2x keeps the cord relaxed and loose.

settings.name: Slack / Water Sag
settings.description: Maximum slack fraction when cursor is close to anchor pins. Governs catenary sag depth and gravitational water drooping.

settings.name: Tendon Thickness
settings.description: Base physical SVG stroke width of the central tendon spine. Features Poisson necking (thins down organically as cord stretches over long spans).

settings.name: Gooey Viscosity (Blur)
settings.description: SVG feGaussianBlur radius in the #goo filter. Merged with high alpha contrast (gooeyContrast: 34) to fuse vertebrae into organic liquid rubber surface tension.

settings.name: Severed Rope Gravity
settings.description: Downward gravitational acceleration applied to joints of severed falling ropes during Verlet integration physics simulation.

settings.name: Spill Drops Count
settings.description: Number of viscous liquid drops erupted per pointer click or mobile touch tap. Drops arc upward with velocity and cascade downward under gravity.

settings.name: Rope Offset Capacity
settings.description: Extra pixel offset buffer added to physical rope capacity on top of page/screen dimensions. Allows extensive weaving down tall pages before FIFO limits pop older pins.

settings.name: Page Length Scale
settings.description: Multiplier applied to total document scroll height (document.documentElement.scrollHeight). Allows the rope to dynamically stretch across the entire scrollable page height without breaking.

settings.name: Use Page Length
settings.description: When true, calculates max rope capacity using the full document scroll height rather than viewport diagonal alone.

settings.name: Anchor Mode
settings.description: 'multi' for sequential waypoint weaving, 'single' for 1 anchor pin that glides with damped spring follow, 'off' to disable.

settings.name: CSS Blend Mode
settings.description: 'difference' (Mendieta text-reveal lens), 'normal' (opaque ink), 'screen' (additive dark-mode cyber glow).
